question: And for the first half of 2026?

report.interpretation: This is a follow-up to the 2025 loss ratio question, so 'that' means loss ratio by product. I used the same definition: incurred (paid plus reserve) divided by earned premium. Claims are counted by loss date from 1 Jan to 30 Jun 2026. Duplicated payment rows from the 'reload-2026-03-14' batch are excluded.
report.answer: For H1 2026, the loss ratio was about 60.4% for home and 57.3% for motor. In 2025 it was 60.5% for home and 56.6% for motor. Home is flat and motor is up slightly. Without removing the duplicate payment rows, the ratios would read 63.1% for home and 60.8% for motor. The duplicates matter more here because they were loaded for March 2026 payments. These figures are also immature. Claims from the most recent months are still being reported, and open claims carry reserves that will change.
report.answer_sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM (SELECT * FROM claim_payments WHERE load_batch NOT LIKE 'reload-%') GROUP BY claim_id), n AS (SELECT c.product, sum(coalesce(pay.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount) inc FROM claims c LEFT JOIN pay USING(claim_id) WHERE loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT product, sum(earned_premium) ep FROM exposure_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT product, round(inc/ep,4) loss_ratio FROM n JOIN d USING(product) ORDER BY product

{"metric": "loss_ratio", "label": "Loss ratio", "unit": "ratio", "definition": "1 * incurred_losses / earned_premium", "sql": "WITH numerator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
               c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
        FROM claims c
        JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
        ) pay USING (claim_id)
    )
    SELECT product, sum(incurred) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND loss_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
),
denominator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT * FROM exposure_monthly
    )
    SELECT product, sum(earned_premium) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND month <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
)
SELECT product, 1 * numerator.value / nullif(denominator.value, 0) AS value
FROM numerator JOIN denominator USING (product)
ORDER BY ALL", "columns": ["product", "value"], "rows": [["home", 0.6132838538619296], ["motor", 0.5669166209339649]], "truncated": false}
